title: Smacked Cucumber and Rice Noodle Salad

replaces.change: The bundled version simmered dried noodles and dressed them with 40 g soy sauce plus sugar. This version keeps the smacked-cucumber identity and cuts soy to 1.5 tbsp lifted by rice vinegar, sugar and toasted sichuan pepper; noodles are soaked, not boiled, and rinsed cold. The 1 tsp draining salt is documented as unmapped (mostly rinsed off - the validator's salty-unmapped flag fires deliberately rather than pretending it is zero).

qty.note: from 75 g dried rice noodles (half a 150 g cake pack), soaked per pack timing, drained and rinsed cold
for drawing water out of the cucumber; rinsed off before dressing, so it is not mapped into the sodium number
blooms the chili flakes - the chili-oil half of the dressing

steps.text: Rolling pin or flat of a knife: smack the cucumber hard enough to split it, then tear it into rough chunks. The broken faces hold dressing in a way knife-cuts never do.
Toss the cucumber with the salt in a sieve set over the sink and leave for 15 minutes. This draws out water that would otherwise dilute the dressing.
Meanwhile put the rice noodles in a heatproof bowl, cover with boiling water, and soak until pliable with a slight bite, about 8 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Toast the sichuan peppercorns in a dry pan for 1 minute until fragrant, then crush them coarsely. Watch for the floral buzz they give off - that is the point of the dish.

Put the chili flakes in a small bowl, heat the oil until it shimmers, and pour it over - it should sizzle and turn brick-red. Pull back on the heat if it smokes; burnt flakes turn the dressing bitter.
Whisk the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar and tahini into the chili oil, loosening with a spoonful of water until pourable. Stir in most of the crushed sichuan pepper.
Rinse the cucumber well under cold water and pat dry - un-rinsed, it stays salty on the surface and seasonless inside.
Toss the noodles and cucumber with the dressing in a wide bowl until every strand is stained amber; taste and sharpen with a splash more vinegar if it sits flat.
Pile into bowls and scatter with green onions, cilantro and the last of the sichuan pepper. Eat immediately - noodles drink dressing as they sit.

nutrition_per_serving.basis: USDA FoodData Central values committed in apps/ios/Resources/usda_ingredient_catalog.sqlite (matched fdc_id per ingredient in tables/nutrition-map.json), plus the app's shipped core-ingredient table (data.json) for items without an fdc_id; scaled by evidenced gram quantities
